sentences.text: For business-purpose loans to Micro and Small Enterprises, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy prepayment charges under the applicable UCB directions, so a 2% pre-payment charge would not comply if that provision applies to the sanction letter.
The bank’s own documents state a 2% foreclosure charge on the principal outstanding for term-loan pre-closure and a 2% pre-payment charge on the principal outstanding for foreclosure or pre-payment.
The evidence provided does not include the sanction date, so the applicability of the UCB pre-payment-charge directions to this sanction letter cannot be confirmed from the record alone.
The UCB directions also say that any pre-payment charge must be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and no undisclosed pre-payment charge may be charged.

missing.searched: Needed to confirm whether the sanction letter falls within the UCB pre-payment-charge directions’ date scope for sanctions or renewals on or after 2026-01-01, as reflected in the rule findings and the cited directions.
